messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — running a small fuzz harness for sentinel-gap offsets during KV priming on the new int4 build. Repro shows token drift / hallucination after ~8k tokens, looks like the sentinel slot is being reused when window wraps. attaching minimal repro logs below.

sam: Can you paste the sentinel pattern and the exact prefill loop you used?

anya: sure — using unique 3-token sentinel repeated between segments. prefill pseudo: ```
for seg in segments:
  prompt = seg + sentinel
  out = model.generate(prompt, use_cache=True)
  insert_past_kv(out.past_key_values)
```
Sentinel token ids: [5023, 17, 2] (rare tokens).

leo: which quant config? int4-per-channel or global? and are you using window-tiling (shard) or single continuous cache?

anya: int4-per-channel, single-shard on dev GPU. no tiling. also noticed the drift only after running `--enable-prefix-cache` + `--kv-prefetch=auto`.

mika: can you try with `--kv-prefetch=off` and `--disable-prefetch` to rule out the prefetch fusion path? I suspect a prefetch stride overflow.

anya: did that — prefetch off delays the issue but doesn't remove it. repro diff shows mismatched pos indices around the wrap boundary (example):
```
KV index expected: 8190..8205
KV index actual: 0..15
rotary_pos expected: 8189 -> 8190
rotary_pos observed: 15 -> 16
```

sam: hmmm. could be pos index truncation when computing offset = (global_pos - base_pos) & mask — maybe mask width mismatch after int4 packing. also check if sentinel tokens get deduped by tokenizer when concatenating segments.

leo: I bet it's a 32-bit vs 64-bit overflow in the stride calc. We added a fast path in kvcache that casts to uint32 for indexing to speed memcpy. if window > 2^32 it would wrap, but we're nowhere near that. still could be signedness bug when subtracting base_pos.

infra-bot: job-8912 started: kv-fuzz-run (sentinel-gap, int4-per-channel) on gpu-dev-07. logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/8912

anya: job finished — attaching CI snippet:
```
[2026-03-12T09:23:44Z] kv_fuzz: segment_count=12, avg_seg_len=740
[2026-03-12T09:23:47Z] kvcache: write_ix=8191, write_len=18 -> wrapped to 0
[2026-03-12T09:23:47Z] model_output_mismatch: sentinel_seen_at=0 expected=8191
```

priyanka: assigning to @leo to add a unit test for sentinel-gap wrapping + int4 path. can we also add a tiny end-to-end regression to the bring-up checklist?

leo: will do. plan: write fuzz harness that inserts randomized sentinel lengths, toggles prefetch flags, and asserts that sentinel tokens in decoded output align to original segment offsets. will add a test that runs in CI smoke (short mode).

sam: also add an invariant check in kvcache write path: assert((write_ix + write_len - base_pos) >= 0) and that we never map an old slot to a new pos without explicit eviction. If failing, dump kv fingerprints.

anya: thanks — I pushed a tiny repro to /tmp/kv-sentinel-repro.tar.gz and linked job. keeping this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
